Subject: Discovery recap — Brightline inference pilot & approval path

Hi Laura / Kevin,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the candidness on throughput and compliance constraints. Below is a short recap and the proposed approval path so we can align next steps. Please confirm or call out any corrections.

Key pain points:
- Current latency for clinical summarization batch jobs spikes to 2.5s/token under load (primary pain).
- Predictable throughput is required for nightly processing windows (11pm–3am PT).
- Data isolation / auditability concerns for PHI in model inputs (SOC2 + customer keying).

Primary goals (30–60 day pilot):
1) Demonstrate sub-1.2s average per-token latency for the 2k-token clinical summarization workload during the nightly window.
2) Safe-handling proof: show end-to-end audit trail + optional KMS-based encryption for payloads.
3) Cost estimate & runbook for scaling to 1.5x peak in production.

Proposed approval path & milestones (first draft):
- Milestone A: Technical pilot kickoff – Redwood demo + infra baseline (owner: Aditya / Mina) – target week of 2026-11-29
- Milestone B: Security evidence & controls exercise (owner: Mina) – provide SOC2 artifacts, KMS integration plan – target 2026-12-06
- Milestone C: Exec finance review (owner: Kevin / Laura) – initial cost model and commercial terms for Dedicated capacity – target 2026-12-13
- Milestone D: Procurement & SOW / signature (legal + procurement) – target 2026-12-20

Stakeholders we heard today (confirm if complete):
- Laura Bennett (Chief Product Officer) – exec sponsor / approval
- Kevin Cho (Head of Platform) – technical sign-off + procurement lead
- Security: (TBD) – will need someone for SOC2 evidence review
- Procurement / Legal: (TBD)

Decision criteria you described: performance (latency), measurable audit logs, and predictable unit economics.

Open items / asks from Brightline:
- Can you share the internal procurement contact and an expected legal review SLA?
- Confirm whether PHI will be redacted pre-ingest or whether you require customer-managed KMS for payloads.

Attachments: Brightline-RI-MAP-v1.pdf (draft MAP, milestones + owners) and Brightline-Security-Checklist.xlsx (initial checklist).

If that looks right, I'll circulate an updated MAP after we get your procurement contact and confirm the security owner. Proposed next checkpoint: 30-minute technical kickoff the week of 2026-11-29 — what days/times work best?

Thanks,

--

Aditya,

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft  very helpful. A few quick notes:

- Milestone A: kickoff week of 11/29 works for us; prefer Tuesday or Wednesday mornings PT.
- Security owner: please add Priya N. from our security team (priya.n@brightlinehealth.com) to the checklist and loop for Milestone B.
- Procurement contact: copying Kevin but procurement will likely run through our vendor intake team; Kevin will loop in the right contact by EOD 11/20.
- Legal review SLA: our legal typically does 7 business days for initial SOW review; faster if the terms are standard.

On the pilot scope: we can confirm PHI will be redacted upstream for the pilot (we'll test both redacted and KMS-managed flows, but redacted is easier to start).

We made one tweak to the timeline: prefer the exec finance review to be the week of 12/13 (you had that) but we'd like the security evidence completed by 12/03 (a week earlier) so that legal has time to review before the 12/13 exec review. Can you accommodate moving Milestone B to 2026-12-03?
